answer: Why does a clone farm go broke here? First, every address parks copper collateral at a wharf, sized as the base deposit times the count of addresses already linked to its operator, so the k-th linked clone posts k units and n clones lock n(n+1)/2. Next, a falcon, a randomly drawn established agent, fires one live question at two addresses within the same second; matching latency and phrasing links them. Finally, a newly linked address that fails to top up its copper within 3 epochs is slashed.
